title: AI agent
welcomeBody: Describe your project. The agent edits the open workspace, validates connections, runs the project with the editor’s installed engines, and reads serial output.
examplePrompt: Blink the LED and print its state to serial. Run the simulation and check the output.
placeholder: Describe your project or a change…
settingsBody: Choose the model used by the agent for this workspace.
unavailable: The agent runtime is unavailable. Check the OpenCode installation on the Velxio server.
urlHelp: Chat Completions-compatible API. This address must be reachable from the Velxio server. In Docker, localhost refers to the container.
modelPlaceholder: Exact ID of the served model
keySaved: Saved key; leave blank to keep it for this server
keyEmpty: Not required for a local server without authentication
outputTokensHelp: Larger values allow longer code but can prolong a stuck response.
contextWindowHelp: Set this to the context size supported by your model server.
testPassed: Connection, streaming, and tool calling verified.
testMissingTools: The endpoint responded, but the model did not call the diagnostic tool.

errors.editorNotReady: The editor connection is not ready. Please try again in a moment.
errors.connection_failed: Cannot reach the model API from the Velxio server.
errors.connection_rejected: The model endpoint rejected the connection. Check the URL, model, and key.
errors.model_required: Choose a model in AI connection settings.
errors.model_error: The model could not complete the request. Check its connection and tool support.
errors.harness_unavailable: The agent runtime is unavailable on the Velxio server.
errors.revision_conflict: The project changed while the agent was working. Your manual edits were preserved.
errors.browser_unavailable: Keep the editor connected to run or observe the simulation.
